evidence.title: Nucleo React Icons – 40,000+ SVG Icons as React Components

name: Nucleo
summary: Bundle of 40,000+ SVG icons with a web app, native apps, React packages and AI coding integrations.
description: 44,282 icons across five families — Core, UI, Sharp, Pixel and Micro Bold — sold with apps to browse, customize and export them. Icons ship as SVG downloads and private npm packages for React; free open-source sets cover glass, flags, arcade, cursor, pattern, isometric and social media icons.
contains: 44,282 icons across Core, UI, Sharp, Pixel and Micro Bold families
free open-source sets: glass, flags, arcade, essential subsets, cursors, patterns
web app and Windows app to browse, customize and export icons
private npm packages and React components for icons
one-time purchases from $69 to $149; all-icons bundle $149 (list $405)
$299/year team plan with shared icon projects and role management
